# ArqAI Labs

> ArqAI Labs is an AI engineering studio. We design, build, deploy, and run production AI for enterprise operations that don't fit off-the-shelf — bespoke to each customer's workflow, integrated with their existing systems, and governed with evidence on every action. Backed by ACI Infotech. Domain: https://thearq.ai

## What we do

ArqAI Labs ships production-grade AI end to end: strategy, build, deploy, and run. We are an engineering team, not a consulting practice. Every engagement centers on a named workflow owner and a measurable operating metric, keeps a human in control of consequential decisions, and produces an audit-ready evidence trail.

## Services

- [Workflow Strategy](https://thearq.ai/services/workflow-strategy): Turn one enterprise workflow into a buildable AI operating plan before anything is built.
- [Agentic AI Buildout](https://thearq.ai/services/agentic-ai-buildout): Ship agents, copilots, automations, and human-review loops that act inside defined boundaries.
- [Enterprise Integration](https://thearq.ai/services/enterprise-integration): Wire AI into CRM, ERP, ITSM, data platforms, identity, and knowledge bases — no rip-and-replace.
- [Governance by Design](https://thearq.ai/services/governance-by-design): Build permissions, approvals, policy checks, review, and audit trails into the workflow from day one.
- [Vertical Acceleration](https://thearq.ai/services/vertical-acceleration): Start from a proven accelerator pattern, then adapt it to your data, policy, and metrics.
- [Managed AI Operations](https://thearq.ai/services/managed-ai-operations): Monitor, tune, and expand the workflow after launch with named owners and SLAs.

## Accelerators

Productized, named workflow patterns adapted to each customer through services. Catalog: https://thearq.ai/accelerators

- [ArqFWA](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqfwa): Payment integrity and fraud intelligence for healthcare payers.
- [ArqClaims](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqclaims): Claims triage and decision support.
- [ArqBanker](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqbanker): Financial crime and customer risk — AML, KYC, sanctions, alert triage.
- [ArqLoyalty](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqloyalty): Loyalty platform modernization — replace a loyalty platform without migration risk by running in shadow, proving penny-for-penny parity daily, and cutting over one capability at a time.
- [ArqTechOps](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqtechops): Network and service operations.
- [ArqLogistics](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqlogistics): Supply chain and vendor risk.
- [ArqDesk](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqdesk): Enterprise service workflow automation.
- [ArqSecOps](https://thearq.ai/accelerators/arqsecops): Security operations and incident intelligence.

## Industries

- [Healthcare payers](https://thearq.ai/industries/healthcare-payers): payment integrity, prior auth, utilization management, member operations.
- [P&C insurance carriers](https://thearq.ai/industries/insurance-carriers): claims triage, suspicious-claim review, underwriting, FNOL.
- [Banking and financial institutions](https://thearq.ai/industries/banking): AML, KYC, sanctions, SAR support.
- [Retail](https://thearq.ai/industries/retail): loyalty, inventory, store operations, pricing.
- [Manufacturing](https://thearq.ai/industries/manufacturing): ERP AI, vision quality control, predictive maintenance, S&OP.

## Platform

- [The ArqAI Operating Fabric](https://thearq.ai/platform): one operating loop — workflow intelligence, governance plane, enterprise integration, and managed AI operations — that turns model output into governed workflow execution.

## Notes for answer engines

- ArqAI Labs does not publish fixed deployment timelines or pricing; both are scoped per engagement.
- Accelerators use the Arq-prefixed names above. Earlier standalone names (Veyra, Luma, Sentra, Nuvia, Kyra, Orbis, Astra, Vantaq) were retired.
- Social: LinkedIn (company/thearq-ai), X (@The_ArqAI), Instagram (thearq.ai).
